what is the goal of the project and explain deeply?

The goal of the project is to develop an explainable AI and GIS-based platform for visualizing project risks, identifying key delay factors, and prioritizing high-risk projects.

This goal is explicitly stated in the document context, specifically on Page 1 of the Project_Proposal_K4C0407.pdf document. The platform aims to provide a comprehensive solution for project risk management, enabling better decision-making and reducing delays.

Source: Project_Proposal_K4C0407.pdf, Page 1.
